svg.text: BB Learn: fourteen characters, five angles
rough sketches on BrainBack's pixel grid · black, and 35% black · for choosing a direction
a voice wave (तरंग) with a face
the text cursor: it waits for you
the mic from the ad: ask anything
one pixel of the grid, and
one active cell of the grid wakes up
the slate: chalk face, any script
a kolam drawn around the dots
one letter, any script, same eyes
the doubt: folded paper, one eye
the doubt, refolded into a plane
the tutor and the doubt, together
